title: Before you buy resistance bands, try your doorframe for two weeks
caption: Back workout without resistance bands: Shoulder Blade Squeeze, Doorframe Lean Row, Doorframe Row and Prone Y Raise. Lean back further to make it harder, and buy a band when all four feel easy for two weeks. Save this before you buy.

overlays.text: Before you buy resistance bands, your doorframe already does this.

scenes.footer: The squeeze every row starts with.

overlays.text: Shoulder Blade Squeeze. 12 reps. Pull your shoulder blades together, then let go.

scenes.footer: Grip a solid frame. A small lean is your light band.

overlays.text: Doorframe Lean Row. 10 reps. Hold the frame, lean back a little, pull yourself in.

scenes.footer: Feet closer, more lean. That is your heavier band.

overlays.text: Doorframe Row. 8 reps. Walk your feet closer, lean back more, pull your chest in.

scenes.footer: No door at all. Your own arms do the work.

overlays.text: Prone Y Raise. 10 reps. Lie face down, arms in a Y, lift them off the floor.

scenes.footer: Until then, you are building that pull with a doorframe.

overlays.text: When all four feel easy for two weeks, a band gives you somewhere new to go.
Which of the four felt hard first?
